decision: The January and July 2024 house-only hearings were continued. Staff recommended approval of the revised house-only design in July. Council denied the later appeal and upheld approval on June 17, 2025.
construction: Main-house and ADU permits show Issued. Revision BLD25-02054-R01 shows Corrections Needed and describes window, bathroom and playroom changes. Final inspection and occupancy are not established.
unknown: Corrected issued plan dimensions, reconciled height/grade and area definitions, completed housing and the design change attributable to HAA.

decision: The November 2024 hearing was postponed for re-noticing. January 2025 minutes document approval and adoption; a later appeal outcome has not been established.
construction: The main-house, ADU and grading records show Corrections Needed. These application-stage observations do not establish issued permits or completed housing.
unknown: Signed operative resolution, earlier versus approved designs, any later appeal/revisions, issuance, final inspections and occupancy.
